name: zclass_copy_node_with_clone_options
description: zClass_cls_util::CopyNodeWithCloneOptions saves the current clone-option globals, installs cloneDiMode and diArg0 around CopyNodeDispatch, restores the saved globals, and returns the dispatched copy.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted for this wrapper in this session. The related zclass_copy_node_wrapper VC5SP3 attempt covers the sibling CopyNode wrapper and currently has known byte mismatches.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x452500 validate the null-node ReportOldNoOp path, __fastcall ECX=source EDX=cloneDiMode ABI with diArg0 as the stack argument, save/restore of g_zClass_CopyNodeCloneDiMode and g_zClass_CopyNodeDiArg0, CopyNodeDispatch call, and dispatched result return.
The native smoke verifies shared-node dispatch passthrough, clone-option global restoration, preservation of diArg1, and null-node return.
